solution: $\left\lbrack \frac{(x + y)^{2} - 4y^{2}}{x^{2} - y^{2}} - \frac{x - y}{x + y} \right\rbrack:\frac{2y}{x + y} = \left\lbrack \frac{(x + y + 2y) \cdot (x + y - 2y)}{(x - y) \cdot (x + y)} - \frac{x - y}{x + y} \right\rbrack:\frac{2y}{x + y} = \left\lbrack \frac{(x + 3y) \cdot (x - y) - (x - y)^{2}}{(x - y) \cdot (x + y)^{-}} \right\rbrack:\frac{2y}{x + y} = \frac{x^{2} + 3xy - xy - 3y^{2} - x^{2} + 2xy - y^{2}}{(x - y) \cdot (x + y)}:\frac{2y}{x + y} = \frac{\left( 4xy - 4y^{2} \right):2y}{x - y} = \frac{2x - 2y}{x - y} = \frac{2(x - y)}{x - y} = 2$
